doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9, FR-003: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/brace-ending-statements.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. Only what the grammar reads as a block opens one, and only a pipeline does: the { that ends the title, a trailing comment and a link's context is a byte of one token and opens nothing, a note's text holds one, and the { alone on line 6 stands where a statement may start and opens nothing either, so no block is open and the braces balance in the reading's terms. The } alone on line 8 closes nothing and is reported as fbl.unmatched-close, the one line the tool reports too; its lines and the { are kept byte for byte. The tool's six identities are the six elements with an identity kind.

steps.doc: The title's { is part of its value: a set replaces the whole text and nothing else.
Kettle's maturity changes its number alone; the trailing comment that ends in { stays.
A component added goes at the end of the document, at the top level: no block is open after the note.
The undo removes the component's line.
The undo of the maturity puts 0.4 back.
